$description: Page grid. Gutter, unit and section gap are fluid like the portfolio: $value is the largest size, $extensions min the smallest, fluid the CSS that moves between them.

gutter.$description: Page margin and column gutter. Fluid, 16px to 40px: the portfolio --gutter clamp, copied exactly.

unit.$description: The base step for page rhythm. Fluid, 8px to 16px: the portfolio --u clamp, copied exactly.

section.$description: Gap between page sections: 8 units, so 64px to 128px as the unit grows.

bp.$description: Min-width breakpoints, taken from the media queries the portfolio uses (measured 17 Nov 2026, ADR 0004). Use the generated @custom-media or the JS export; CSS variables cannot sit inside a media query.

medium.$description: Phones end. The portfolio switches at 599/600px in 6 queries.

expanded.$description: Tablets end, two-column layouts start. The portfolio's main switch: 899/900px in 25 queries.

large.$description: Full desktop grid. The portfolio switches at 1199px.

xlarge.$description: Wide screens. The portfolio adds a step at 1440px.
